headline: OCC Encourages Community Banks to Enter Stablecoin Payments Market
summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency is urging smaller U.S. lenders to develop stablecoin services ahead of upcoming federal licensing requirements.
why: The OCC is a principal federal banking regulator in the United States, overseeing the operations of national banks and federal savings associations.

impacts.name: Banking and Payments
impacts.why: Regulatory encouragement for community banks to adopt stablecoins could expand blockchain-based payment adoption across traditional financial institutions.
